purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system for Japanese medical billing. It implements a screen-based master settings program (ORCGZ03) for managing point/score (Tensu) master data used in medical fee calculation, including validity dates, treatment classification codes, calculation rules, age-based adjustments, and facility standard settings. It is a batch/online screen program for configuring medical procedure master records.
